_readme: THE PILOT'S CONFIG. Build with:  node scripts/b12-manifest.mjs plan b12-corpus/manifest-config.json --pilot-only
Keys beginning with _ are ignored by parseManifestConfig; they are notes for whoever fills this in.
EVERY PIN BELOW IS IN ONE OF THREE STATES, and the distinction is the point:
KNOWN HERE  - computed on the authoring machine and already filled in.
MAC-LOCAL   - null, because only the run machine can know it. The tool REFUSES on null;
a plausible-looking placeholder would VALIDATE, which is worse than a refusal.
OWNER       - null, because it is a choice nobody has made yet. See _ownerDecisions.
Do not replace a null with a guess to make the tool quiet. The refusal is the deliverable.
_pilotRunId: Rename to the date the pilot actually runs. It names evidence/<pilotRunId>.b12.pilot-<taskId>.manifest.json and, after the run, evidence/<pilotRunId>.b12.pilot.json.
_pilot: ORDERED, and the order is load-bearing: committedOrderViolation runs for every treatment arm and is NOT under the pilotMode exemption, so each of these ships as its own single-task manifest with its task at index 0. All five are excluded from manifests A and B by design.artifacts 4.
_manifestsAandB: ABSENT ON PURPOSE. runPlan PHASE 2 precedes PHASE 4 — the pilot runs before the sealed manifests exist. --pilot-only is what expresses that; without it the tool would demand 60 authored siblings before emitting five pilot manifests.

_knownHere.ratesSha256: sha256 of .local-coder/rates.json at the shared green parent. Compared inside EACH base commit's own tree by assertRatesFrozen, so it is a property of the corpus, not of a machine.
_knownHere.b12RunSha256: sha256 of scripts/b12-run.mjs at 608e930. GOES STALE THE MOMENT THAT FILE CHANGES — observe asserts the running harness IS the sealed one, so recompute if you touch it before the run.
_knownHere.claudeMdSha256: sha256 of the in-repo CLAUDE.md at 608e930.
_knownHere.scoringCommand: voidConditions 19: the ONE string committed at pre-registration. Change it here and nowhere else.
_knownHere.perArmTimeoutMs: 45 minutes. Declared rather than left to the silent fallback, which manifestDeclarationGaps refuses.
_knownHere.extraArgs: Empty, deliberately: a non-empty value forces an installedChars RE-PROBE (b12-run.mjs:1911).

_macLocal.claudeCodeVersion: The FULL x.y.z on the run machine. assertPinned compares with .includes(), so a partial pin like 2.1.2 silently matches 2.1.221 — the assembler refuses anything that is not x.y.z.  claude --version
_macLocal.claudeBinarySha256: sha256 of the Claude Code binary that will run.  shasum -a 256 $(which claude)
_macLocal.clientTruncationCap: The cap MEASURED for that version. voidConditions 8 VOIDS a run with no cap measured for the version that ran.  scripts/b12-truncationcap-probe-mac.sh
_macLocal.settingsSha256s: BOTH keys required, and null is a legitimate value meaning 'this file does not exist' — omission declares nothing, null declares an absence.
_macLocal.installedCharsProbe: Path to the committed probe artifact, plus its sha256. The re-probe is OWED with the orchestrator model in the calibration key (PREMISES.md, sixth decision).  scripts/b12-installedchars-probe-mac.sh
_macLocal.mcpConfig: Path to the generated MCP config, plus its sha256. observe dereferences both and NO validator checks them; the path is machine-local, so presence is all this machine can assert.
_macLocal.policyBlobs: One {repo, commit, path, sha256} per arm, for the OUT-OF-REPO policy bundles. The repo must exist on the run machine, be a full (not shallow) clone, and resolve OUTSIDE this repository — findPolicyBlob refuses an in-repo path as in-repo policy wearing an out-of-repo name.
_macLocal.memorySnapshot: Directory of the memory snapshot, plus its sha256. FOUND LATE AND WORTH SAYING WHY: observe REQUIRES this (b12-run.mjs:1690, citing voidConditions 13) and manifestDeclarationGaps never asks for it — so before the assembler was taught to check it, a manifest could pass every build-time check in this repository and then refuse on the run machine.
_macLocal.captureSha256: sha256 of the built dist/ capture. Its absence is SILENTLY PERMISSIVE rather than refusing: observe compares only `if (want)` (b12-run.mjs:2040), so leaving it null-and-unfilled means the capture ships unverified. STATE.md's standing note — re-pin this at the seal — is the same instruction from the other end.

_ownerDecisions.pacingCacheWriteShareCeiling: One of thresholdArgument's two CHOSEN constants, to be committed BEFORE any observation. No value is stated anywhere in the frozen text or in PREMISES.md — the fixture's 1 is test material and must not be copied in.
_ownerDecisions.perTaskDenominatorShareCap: The other one. Same status: chosen, not derived, and not yet chosen.
_ownerDecisions._note: These two are the reason a pilot cannot be assembled today even with the Mac's values in hand. They are yours, they are pre-data, and they are free until the first scored observation.

_transport: A plain git fetch brings NO base — measured. Tag auto-following only takes tags pointing into fetched history, and these bases are detached.
Then, ON THE MAC, before spending anything:  node scripts/b12-author.mjs verify-corpus b12-corpus/pilot-plan.json --deep
